page: Microsoft Azure EC4es_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEV6 server family. It is powered by an Intel processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external volumes. It is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance remote storage options. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and it does not feature any GPU acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the EC4es_v6 offers a dense memory allocation relative to its processing cores, making it a viable option for workloads that require significant memory capacity without the overhead of high CPU core counts. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications, small-scale database hosting, caching layers, and enterprise applications that benefit from Premium Storage integration.
